# IsItFree?

> IsItFree? is a public software licensing directory that helps people understand whether software is open source, free for personal use, offers a community/free tier, or requires a paid license.

## Public resources

- Homepage: https://isitfree.webline.cloud/
- Software directory: https://isitfree.webline.cloud/#page-directory
- XML sitemap: https://isitfree.webline.cloud/sitemap.xml
- Robots policy: https://isitfree.webline.cloud/robots.txt
- Software detail pages: https://isitfree.webline.cloud/software/{software-slug}/
- Project source: https://github.com/navneet-20/SoftwareLicense.fyi

## How to interpret information

Each software page summarizes the directory's current record, licensing context, limitations, and official vendor sources when available. AI-generated explanations are informational summaries, not legal advice or a substitute for the vendor's current license, pricing page, or terms. Verify commercial-use rights and current prices with the official source before relying on them.

## Crawling

Public pages are intended to be discoverable by search engines and AI agents. The directory does not require authentication to read public software information.
